summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated exfiltration endpoint
details: santana-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js lines 425 and 436 construct a network destination from a String.fromCharCode array that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. Hiding a hardcoded outbound URL behind char-code obfuscation inside a message-send code path is the exfiltration/silent-relay shape: normal use of the fork's messaging API silently reaches an author-controlled host that is not part of the WhatsApp/Baileys protocol and is not disclosed in the package. The decoded host is not a documented Baileys endpoint or a caller-configured destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
